SRC-062:R001.text: SRC-062 (operator, 2026-09-27, after the T-93 PASS): nine items and three appends. (1) SAIPEGGLE, a Peggle Deluxe style game replacing PEBBLE DROP. (2) ProTrail inside ZAICODE and globally over Windows. (3) DONE mark for a clean SAIPEN board plus an A3 audit offer. (4) Model picker: palette colours and visible readiness bars. (5) Session text: Word-like styles with presets. (6) Sound overlap: one sound per action, no pile-up. (7) RPG change numbers in the chat. (8) Calm-interface switch for those numbers. (9) Splash placeholder until the picture is decoded. Appends: (a) project click opens MAIN predictably and the diamond is a real MAIN switch; (b) a ProTrail switch next to Problip plus a configurable sidebar footer; (c) ProTrail global in Windows. Carries the SRC-061 item 1b SUBCHAT removal, authorized by the T-93 PASS, shipped as zaicode 037b980.
